subject: Request: operator attestation & transport traces for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@stratagem.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Xu <michael.xu@auditsvc.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: operator attestation & transport traces for SIG/CAIQ review

Connor —

Thanks for taking this. As part of Stratagem's SIG/CAIQ intake we need a short operator attestation and a sample of transport traces demonstrating TLS session establishment and inter-service encryption for your KMS/HSM-backed key operations. Specifically we're looking for: 

- A concise operator statement that confirms operator separation, shift-handling procedures, and sealed-key custody responsibilities (1–2 pages).
- A time-limited sample of transport traces (pcap/CSV export) showing TLS handshakes and mutual TLS or client cert usage when a tenant requests key unwrap/derive operations. Redact tenant IDs as needed.
- A short summary of key-rotation cadence and the last three rotation events for the customer-managed KMS instances (dates + operator initials is fine).

Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Our auditor (Michael Xu) is copied on this thread and would like to review the artifacts by 8/21 to meet our internal deadline. 

Attachments: none (but Michael can follow up if he needs samples of acceptable formats).

Best,
Alice
Alice Moreno
Security Engineer, Stratagem.io
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@stratagem.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Xu <michael.xu@auditsvc.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator attestation & transport traces for SIG/CAIQ review

Alice —

Thanks; happy to help. We can provide the following by 2029-08-21: 

- Operator attestation (PDF, signed) describing operator separation, shift rotation, custody practices, and our HSM access controls.
- Transport trace sample exported as CSV with payloads redacted; will include TLS handshake logs and mutual-auth indicators (SNI, cipher suite, cert thumbprints).
- Rotation summary for the last three scheduled rotations (dates + operator initials).

A few clarifying questions so we scope correctly: 
1) Do you need full pcap files or is a CSV export with session metadata acceptable? (We prefer CSV for audit delivery.)
2) Any restrictions on including internal hostnames in the traces? We can replace hostnames with pseudonyms if required.

Laura (CC'd) will pull the HSM operator shift logs and the rotation history; Ben I'm looping in for any commercial redaction constraints. If you confirm CSV is OK and pseudonymizing hostnames is acceptable, we'll proceed and aim to upload to a shared Drive folder and provide a DocuSign-signed attestation.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Head of Field Security
Redwood Inference

---- Forwarded message ----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator attestation & transport traces for SIG/CAIQ review

Connor —

I'll take the logs. Quick notes for the artifact pack: 

- HSM shift logs: I will pull a 30-day window but will include a compact sample (tar.gz) with shifts instrumented, operator ids (initials), and signed BSM audit markers. File: hsm-shift-log-sample.tar.gz (contains shift-manifest.csv + signed-audit-lines.log).
- Transport traces: infra can export CSV session metadata from the packet broker (timestamp, src/dest pseudo-host, SNI, TLS version, cipher). I'll ask them to remove payloads; we'll include a short readme describing redaction steps.
- Rotation history: rotation-events.csv with the last three scheduled rotations for the tenant-type in question (dates + operator initials + rotation reason).

Ben — are there any contractual items we need to redact beyond hostnames (e.g., customer emails) before we share?

I'll start the exports now and aim to have the tars/CSVs in the Drive folder Connor creates by EOD tomorrow.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Principal Security Engineer — Cryptography Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator attestation & transport traces for SIG/CAIQ review

Alice / Michael —

Attached are the deliverables we discussed and a link to the secure Drive folder: 

- Operator attestation (requested-operator-statement.pdf) — signed via DocuSign. The attestation covers operator separation, dual-authorization for HSM key import/export, shift rotation cadence, and emergency rewrap procedures.
- Transport trace sample (transport-traces-sample.csv) — session-level export, payloads removed, hostnames pseudonymized as HOST-A/B/C. CSV includes timestamp, client_ip (anonymized), server_pseudonym, SNI, tls_version, cipher, cert_thumbprint.
- HSM shift log sample (hsm-shift-log-sample.tar.gz) — contains shift-manifest.csv (operator initials + UTC timestamps) and signed-audit-lines.log (BSM markers).
- Rotation summary (rotation-events.csv) — last three rotations for the managed-KMS fleet with operator initials and rotation notes.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbC9xQk-ExampleLink
DocuSign attestation: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
Jira ticket: SEC-4829 (for trace export and redaction work)

Notes on redaction: Customer-identifying fields have been pseudonymized. Where required by contract we can provide a redacted and a fully redacted version; let us know if you need the latter for auditor review.

If Michael needs native pcap files for deeper packet analysis we can schedule a short controlled export, but we prefer auditors work from the CSV summary for portability and data minimization.

Next steps: Please confirm receipt and if the artifacts meet the auditor's needs; we'll mark SEC-4829 for closure once you confirm.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Head of Field Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: requested-operator-statement.pdf, transport-traces-sample.csv, hsm-shift-log-sample.tar.gz
